title: U.S. Still Shares Intelligence With Ukraine, Both Say, Amid Fears It Could Stop
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Kyiv had received no early warning of a Russian missile attack, after an apparent U.S. threat to halt intelligence sharing, but officials say the sharing continues.
